summary: Independent verification completed for Node20.19.2 native install/build path after scramjet npm removal. Strict clean installs and production builds passed with and without lockfile; dependency guard and core API tests passed; calculator and web smoke remained functional.
action_items: No blocking fix identified for this Node20 dependency/build bug.
Optional: monitor/clean non-blocking Yarn resolution and peer warnings in future maintenance.
critical_code_review_comments: No remaining @mercuryworkshop/scramjet npm dependency or lockfile entry detected; vendored runtime assets are still referenced and served.
Node20.19.2 strict install command now succeeds in clean fixtures for both lock and no-lock scenarios; production build succeeds in both.
Lockfile still resolves expected safe graph: compute-engine 0.27.0 and transitive 0.24.1, mathlive 0.103.0, katex 0.18.4, commander 8.3.0; forbidden CE 0.135/0.58 and commander 15 not found.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Used exact Node binary path from one-time npx lookup (/root/.npm/_npx/.../node/bin/node), then executed installs outside wrapper env with npm_config_call/npm_config_package/YARN_IGNORE_ENGINES unset. With-lock and no-lock strict installs + builds passed. Optional wrapper command also passed after scramjet npm removal. Scramjet public assets returned HTTP 200 with expected content-types and sizes.
rca of the issue: Previous blocker was package-manager enforcement from unused @mercuryworkshop/scramjet preinstall during strict clean install. After dependency removal, mandated Node20.19.2 install/build flow completes successfully while preserving vendored runtime assets and browser behavior.
